home_title: Guess the Speed | The Internet Speed Guessing Game for Families
home_description: A free family game: everyone guesses the Wi-Fi download and upload speed, then a real speed test reveals who came closest. Play on one screen or on everyone's phone.
home_schema_feature_real_test: Run a real speed test against Cloudflare’s network in the browser.
home_schema_feature_shared_screen: Play with one or more players on one screen, with room-code games supporting up to 12 players.
home_schema_feature_separate_phones: Use room codes to play on separate phones.
home_schema_feature_private_guesses: The room server hides guesses from other players until the test result.
home_schema_feature_scoring: Award 3, 2, and 1 place points plus a spot-on bonus for each speed guess within 5%.
home_schema_feature_threshold: Require an average miss of 50% or less to earn place points.
home_schema_feature_themes: Choose light, dark, or seasonal themes.
home_lede: Guess the download and upload, run a real speed test, and see who comes closest.
home_room_description: Keep every guess on its owner’s screen until the real speed test is done.
home_round_step_one: Each player privately guesses download and upload speed in Mbps.
home_round_step_two: Press start. A real test runs against Cloudflare’s network.
home_round_step_three: The closest average guess earns the most points.
home_both_numbers_body: Most home plans upload more slowly than they download. Guessing both makes the game extra interesting.
home_story_body: It started with a speed test on our living-room TV and two kids who guess the number right every time. Dad loses on purpose. Mostly.
home_download_help: How fast will a big download feel?
home_upload_help: How fast will sharing a file feel?
home_guesses_hidden: Your guesses stay hidden until the test is over.
home_room_expiry: Room codes expire after six hours without activity.
